info.name: Crusoe Managed Inference
info.description:
OpenAI-compatible API for open-weight models (GLM 5.2, DeepSeek V3, gpt-oss-120b, Gemma 4, Kimi K2.6, Llama 3.3) on Crusoe's AI cloud.

Setup: create an Inference API key in the Crusoe Console (https://console.crusoecloud.com/) under Security > Inference API Key, then set the CRUSOE_API_KEY collection variable.

Docs: https://docs.crusoecloud.com/managed-inference/overview
Pricing: https://crusoe.ai/cloud/pricing

request.description: Basic chat completion with GLM 5.2. Reasoning models return their thinking in the message field named 'reasoning'.
Server-sent events stream of completion chunks.
The model responds with a tool_calls array instead of content when it decides to call the function.
gpt-oss-120b accepts reasoning_effort low, medium, or high, which scales reasoning length. On GLM 5.2, Kimi K2.6, and Gemma 4, reasoning_effort acts as an on/off toggle ('none' disables reasoning).
Request JSON output. Gemma 4 31B is the recommended model for structured output.
